summary: Stored website 403 (unread). Village has no web page; read the Great Rivers & Routes and Enjoy Illinois listings, RV Life and a dated Dyrt review. Rate $25 camper-reported (7/2024). Hookups 50 A/water/sewer (tourism listings), showers, dump. Phone added 618-653-4421. Site layout and exact location not confirmed; not waterfront kept. Season unknown.
flags: WEBSITE: https://www.greatriverroad-illinois.org/Kampsville-Campground -> https://www.riversandroutes.com/directory/village-of-kampsville-campground/ (stored link answers 403; the same tourism bureau's current listing is live). The village itself has no web page; both are tourism directories.

PHONE: none -> 618-653-4421 (listed for the campground by Great Rivers & Routes, Enjoy Illinois and RV Life; whether it is the village hall is not stated - the hall is at 240 W. Oak St. per a 2022 River County News report).
FEES: $25 is camper-reported (The Dyrt, July 2024), allowed because the operator has no web page; RV Life avg_rate 25 agrees.

LOCATION/PIN (reviewer): stored 39.29786,-90.61115 sits in the residential grid west of IL-100, near the 210 W. Oak St. address, with no campground visible. The Dyrt places the campground at 39.2990,-90.6090 on the riverside green east of the village (~220 m from the pin), and its 2024 reviewer calls it riverside. Imagery shows no identifiable pads or pedestals in either place, so no move is made; the true site location (and with it the waterfront call) needs confirming.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. If the sites are on the riverside green, the Illinois River is ~50-100 m east over open grass, which could support riverfront - but no site positions are known, and aggregator 'directly on the river' prose cannot earn it.
SEASON: no season published anywhere read; season left unset.
BOOKING: no reservation channel found; payment at the village hall (camper report). Booking left unset.
SITES: pull_through true (stored, note-derived) agrees with the Great Rivers & Routes amenity list; no site count published.
